---
description: gm_project as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
doing: working on a group's project
arguments:
  act: "start, pause, resume, drop or note: what is done to the project."
  org: "The organization the project belongs to; left out when the project is named."
  template: "start: the project's template, from the world's list."
  project: "The project, by name, for every act but start."
  name: "start: a name of its own for the project."
  account: "start: the account that pays for it."
  step: "note: the step it concerns."
  days: "note: how many days a step is set back."
  amount: "note: how much more a step costs, in the world's main coin."
  why: "Why, in words; kept with the change."
  source: "Where it comes from: from is prose, lore, author, gm, character, player, default or invented; lore, message and roll cite an entry, a message or a roll by id; an invention cites its gap_check and consent."
  precision: "How exact: exact, approximate, vague or unknown."
  standing: "How it stands: established, proposed or assumed."
---
Starts, pauses, resumes or drops a production project of an organization, or notes a step of one set back or made dearer. A project is started from a template by the organization and named after that; each change carries its why.
